comment: AG8 scripted-agent fixtures, shared by agentic_probe.py (client side: sessions, tool results, sub-agent wiring) and mock_backend.py (server side: tool-call steps, final completions, per-model completion rates and token budgets). Every field is deterministic so two runs of the same fixture produce byte-identical conversations.

sessions.description: single user turn, no tool calls, immediate final answer
four assistant turns inside one tool loop before completion
main loop delegates to a sub-agent that runs its own loop under a second agent identity header

sessions.correction_text: Actually, name it load_config instead, and update the src/limiter.py call sites.
